note: Summaries written in our own words. Follow the link for the full story. Only items from the last ~2 weeks; every link checked.

items.title: Verstappen wins in Singapore on his 250th start
items.summary: Max Verstappen led every lap at Marina Bay for his first win there, with Charles Leclerc second and Kimi Antonelli third.

items.title: Antonelli could clinch the title in Austin
items.summary: Antonelli can become the youngest champion at the US GP on Oct 25, but only if he wins, George Russell finishes ninth or lower, and Lewis Hamilton finishes fifth or lower.

items.title: Red Bull keeps Mekies through 2031
items.summary: Red Bull extended team boss Laurent Mekies's contract to 2031 as it builds on its recent turnaround.

items.title: Racing Bulls still deciding its 2027 line-up
items.summary: Team principal Alan Permane says Liam Lawson, Arvid Lindblad and F2 driver Nikola Tsolov are in contention for two seats, with a call due in the coming weeks.

items.title: Haas seat: Camara vs. Doohan
items.summary: With Esteban Ocon leaving Haas, Ferrari junior Rafa Camara and Jack Doohan are reportedly the two front-runners for the 2027 seat. Nothing is confirmed yet.

items.title: Cadillac may change both drivers
items.summary: A Swiss newspaper report says Cadillac is weighing replacing both Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas for 2027, possibly opening a door for Ocon. The team hasn't commented.

items.title: 2027 F2 and F3 calendars drop Spa and Budapest
items.summary: F2 adds Mexico City and Istanbul Park and keeps Montreal, leaving just five of 14 rounds in Europe. F3 adds Jeddah and Montreal and ends its season at Istanbul.

items.title: Stromsted steps up to F2 with Invicta
items.summary: Danish driver Noah Stromsted moves up from F3 to join Freddie Slater at Invicta Racing for 2027.

items.title: Rodin promotes Badoer to F2
items.summary: Brando Badoer, a Monaco feature-race winner in F3 this year, moves up with Rodin for 2027.

items.title: Tsolov eyes a comeback in the title fight
items.summary: After losing the points lead to Rafael Camara in Baku, Nikola Tsolov says he is focused on his own performance for the last two rounds in Lusail and Yas Marina.

items.title: F2 leader Camara reportedly picked for Haas
items.summary: Reports citing paddock sources say Haas settled on Rafael Camara for its 2027 seat during the Singapore weekend. No announcement has been made.

items.title: Tsolov may wait another year for F1
items.summary: Paddock talk suggests Racing Bulls will keep Lawson and Lindblad, which would leave Tsolov as a reserve in 2027. Others predict the opposite, and nothing is decided.

items.title: Rodin keeps Clerot and adds Seewooruthun
items.summary: Pedro Clerot returns for a second F3 season with Rodin, joined by Formula Regional Europe graduate Reza Seewooruthun.

items.title: Sebastian Wheldon joins Trident
items.summary: FRECA runner-up Sebastian Wheldon steps up to F3 with Trident for 2027.

items.title: Hitech completes its 2027 line-up
items.summary: Hitech confirmed Keanu Al Azhari, set to be the first Emirati in F3, plus returning Kanato Le, alongside Woohyun Shin.

items.title: Eurocup-3 champion Egozi signs with LN4 Fusion
items.summary: American James Egozi is the first signing for the new LN4 Fusion F3 team after dominating Eurocup-3 this year.

items.title: Yevan David moves to Van Amersfoort
items.summary: After a rookie year that included a Silverstone sprint podium, Yevan David switches to VAR for his second F3 season.
